description: Generate a professional survey using AI based on a research goal. Returns the survey ID and shareable link.

goal.description: Describe what you want to research. E.g. 'Customer satisfaction survey for our SaaS product after onboarding'

lang.description: Language for the survey content. Defaults to 'en'.

publish.description: Whether to immediately publish the survey after creation. Defaults to false.

name: create_survey
